description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Brilliant Halo.
Brilliant Halo triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying two life, targeting Hero of Iroas.
Defiler of Faith and Hero of Iroas triggers.
Resolve the Hero or Iroas trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.
